name: @maktaba/store
description: The Maktaba plugin store (Epic 54): its signer and verifier (story 54.14), its Cloudflare Workers, D1 migrations, accounts, checks, review, catalog and ratings (stories 54.15-54.18), and paid plugins (story 54.19): the pluggable payment providers, the provider-neutral ledger, entitlements and payouts. Independent of Maktaba Cloud: nothing here imports cloud/.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.workers.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.console.json --noEmit
scripts.test: tsx scripts/gen-vectors.ts --check && tsx scripts/gen-data.ts --check && npm run typecheck && vitest run
